questions.question:
A book has been co-authored by X and Y. The prices of the book in India and abroad are Rs. 800 and Rs. 1000 respectively. The royalties earned on sale in India and abroad are 10% and 16% respectively. The royalty amount is distributed among X and Y in the ratio 5 : 3. The given Bar Graph presents the number of copies of the book sold in India (A) and abroad (B) during 2012-16.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/194fa32f7c00b59516ca735cc722da93be06bfde812fa86905109d48bbf1220f.png] 

What is the difference between the royalties earned by X and Y (in Rs.) during the years 2014 and 2015 taken together?
questions.solution:
Number of copies sold in India in 2014 and 2015 = 3.5 + 5 = 8.5 × 100 = 850

Number of copies sold in abroad in 2014 and 2015 = 4.5 + 5.5 = 10 × 100 = 1000

Selling amount in India = 850 × 800 = 680000

Selling amount in abroad = 1000 × 1000 = 1000000

Royalty received in India = 850 × 800 = 680000 × 10/100 = 68000

Royalty received in abroad = 1000000 × 16/100 = 160000

Total royalty = 68000 + 160000 = 228000

The royalty amount is distributed among X and Y in the ratio = 5 : 3

8 unit = 228000

⇒ 2 unit = 57000

Difference between the royalties earned by x and Y = Rs. 57000

questions.question: A shopkeeper normally allows a discount of 10% on the marked price of each article. During a sale season, he decides to give two more discounts, the first being at a rate of 50% of the original and the second at a rate of 40% of the first. What is the percentage rate of the equivalent single discount (correct up to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount percent on the marked price = 10%

Discount percent in the first case = 50% of 10 

Discount percent in the second case = 40% of the first case

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be Rs 100

⇒ Discount = 10% = 1/10 = (10 - 1)/10 = 9/10

S.P = 9/10 × 100 = 90

Now, Discount percent in the first case = 50% of 10 

⇒ 50/100 × 10 = 5%

And, Discount percent in the second case = 40% of the first case

⇒ 40/100 × 5 = 2%

Now the selling price in season is, 

⇒ 90 × (100 - 5)/100 × (100 - 2)/100

⇒ 90 × 95/100 × 98/100 

⇒ 83.79

Hence the actual discount is, 

⇒ 100 - 83.79 = 16.21

**∴ The percentage rate of the equivalent single discount 16.21%**

questions.question: A borrows a sum of Rs. 2,000 from his friend B on 31 December 2011 on the condition that he will return the same after one year with simple interest at 8% per annum. However, A gets into a position of returning the money on 1 July 2012. How much amount he has to return to B?
questions.solution:
Principal = 2000

Time = 6/12 = 1/2 years

Rate = 8%

Interest = (2000 × 8 × 1)/2 × 100 = 80

Amount = 2000 + 80 = Rs. 2080

questions.question: Which among the following is an irrational quantity?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Evaluate the **standard trigonometric values** for each option:

1) tan 30° × tan 60° = (1/√3) × √3 = 1 (**Rational**)

2) sin 30° = 1/2 = 0.5 (**Rational**)

3) tan 45° = 1 (**Rational**)

4) cos 30° = √3/2 ≈ 0.866... Since √3 is a **non-perfect square root**, it is an **irrational quantity**.

**∴ The correct answer is cos 30°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Four trigonometric quantities to identify the irrational one.

**Formula Used:** cos θ = Adjacent / Hypotenuse | tan θ = Opposite / Adjacent | sin θ = Opposite / Hypotenuse

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66c5e2310e8a8055156fd0436027217d812d9cb53778d209a8b472a3fb9c9f9a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Option 1:** tan 30° × tan 60° = (1/√3) × (√3/1) = 1. Since 1 is an integer, it is **rational**.

⇒ **Option 2:** sin 30° = 1 / 2 = 0.5. Since it can be written as a fraction p/q, it is **rational**.

⇒ **Option 3:** tan 45° = 1. This is a whole number, hence **rational**.

⇒ **Option 4:** cos 30° = Adjacent / Hypotenuse = √3 / 2.

⇒ Since √3 is an **irrational number** (approx. 1.73205...), dividing it by a rational number (2) results in an **irrational quantity**.

**∴ The correct answer is cos 30°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Irrational Numbers

Real numbers that cannot be expressed as a simple fraction p/q. Their decimal expansion is non-terminating and non-recurring (e.g., π, √2, √7).

Trigonometric Ratios of 30°

Values for 30° are: sin 30° = 1/2, cos 30° = √3/2, tan 30° = 1/√3. Only sin 30° results in a purely rational value among these primary ratios.

Square Roots Property

The square root of any **prime number** or any number that is **not a perfect square** is always an irrational number.</p

questions.question: Rs. 10,000/- has to be distributed among 3 craftsmen, 5 helpers and 6 laborer’s such that each helper receives the amount twice as much as a laborer receives and each craftsman received the amount thrice as much as a laborer receives. What is the amount received by the three craftsman?
questions.solution:
Ratio of the amount of helper to laborer = 2 × 5 : 1 × 6 = 5 : 3

Ratio of the amount of craftsman to laborer = 3 × 3 : 1 × 6 = 3 : 2

Ratio of the amount of helper, laborer and craftsman = 10 : 6 : 9

Amount received by craftsman = 10000 × 9/25 = Rs. 3600
